caseName: Eli Lilly & Co. v. Barr Laboratories, Inc.
caseNameFull: Eli Lilly & Co. v. Barr Laboratories, Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. Fed. Cir. Motions of Biotechnology Industry Organization et al. and Intellectual Property Owners Association for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions and this petition.
